## Notes

Shining Rock Software, Luke Hodorowicz; Windows 2014-02-18; citizens are the primary resource; workplace assignment; aging, births, nomads; fire and starvation hazards; mod support from patch 1.04 (November 2014); Anno series cited as a big inspiration, combat left out.
